name: Vraj Patel

experience.title: Founder & Captain, FTC Teams #27964 & #32514
experience.organization: William Lyon Mackenzie CI, Toronto, ON
bullets: Founded a school robotics program with a general robotics club, appointed technical leads, and led 50+ members across two FTC teams.
Led the FTC mechanical sub-team, designing the mecanum drivetrain and manipulator arm in Fusion 360 and assembling the school's first competition robot in two months.
Led weekly Arduino workshops and school outreach, introducing 100+ students to electronics and programming.

experience.title: Database Designer (Co-op)
bullets: Automated Intune, Defender, and remote-monitoring reports with PowerShell and Power BI, replacing manual Excel reports.
Built Power BI dashboards from ConnectWise API data, giving IT staff access to account information for 100 users.

projects.title: ESP32 Quadcopter | C++, ESP32
bullets: Built a transmitter around an F310 gamepad and ESP32-S3, sending throttle, roll, pitch, yaw, and arm/disarm commands over ESP-NOW.
Assembled an F450 quadcopter with an ESP32 flight controller running esp-fc for takeoff, hover, and manual flight.
Wired an MPU-6500 IMU, BMP280 barometer, and QMC5883L magnetometer to the quadcopter's ESP32 over I2C for motion, pressure, and heading measurements.

projects.title: 6-DOF Robotic Arm | Python, Arduino
bullets: Designed and assembled a 3D-printed arm with six servos, two at the shoulder, and a NEMA-17 stepper base.
Programmed the arm to reach typed 3D coordinates using Python inverse kinematics, keeping each joint within its limits.
Developed an interface with sliders and a 3D arm view to control the arm over a serial link to Arduino.

projects.title: Guitar Effects Pedal PCBs | KiCad
bullets: Created KiCad layouts and Gerber files for Boss DS-1, Big Muff Pi, and EHX LPB-1 pedals from existing schematics.
Soldered and debugged three working through-hole pedals, applying gain staging, clipping, and biasing.

award.title: 1st Place in Canada - CyberTitan 2026
award.detail: National cybersecurity competition; six-person team; Windows system hardening.

skills: Hardware & fabrication: ESP32, RP2040, STM32, Raspberry Pi, soldering, 3D printing
